frames.subject: cat's eye inner vane colour swatch (red)
frames.prompt: Flat square texture swatch that fills the entire frame edge to edge: the coloured glass ribbon from inside a cat's eye marble, seen straight on as if unrolled flat. Long smooth flowing vertical streaks of saturated crimson and scarlet glass paint, with thin darker oxblood striations and a few bright cherry highlights, slight translucent glassy depth, soft gradients between streaks. Even flat lighting, no shadows, no specular glare, no marble, no sphere, no background, no border. Orthographic texture map for a 3D material, photoreal macro detail. No text, no logos, no watermark.
frames.transformations: none; stored exactly as delivered by the provider CDN

runtimeDerivative.use: embedded in parble-render (include_bytes) as the vane colour for the High-tier vane mesh and the Low/Medium fallback shader
